questions.stem: Which among the following is CORRECT regarding the healing of leprosy if left untreated?
questions.stemHtml: Which among the following is CORRECT regarding the healing of leprosy if left untreated?

options.label: B
options.text: Half of the cases Resolve Spontaneously After Bacilli Exposure

options.label: C
options.text: Spontaneous Remission is more common in Children than in Adults

options.label: D
options.text: Indeterminate Leprosy has more Remission than Tuberculoid Leprosy
